content.short: Pop Up World Token powers an entrepreneurial ecosystem on Cardano for startups and creative ventures.
content.description: Pop Up World Token ($PUW) is the primary utility token for a platform dedicated to supporting entrepreneurs and new business initiatives. Built on Cardano, the project provides a suite of tools for company formation, investor connection, and market visibility. Startups can use $PUW to access professional services, while community members earn rewards for engaging with the platform. By bridging the gap between traditional business needs and decentralized funding, Pop Up World creates a collaborative environment where new ideas can thrive and scale using blockchain technology.
